corrections.previous_scope_problem: The prior risk register wording could be read as evidence that Qwen3.5-4B itself reproduces the reported cache regression.
corrections.corrected_observation: Issue #23589 reports the regression on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Its published cross-model test explicitly lists Qwen3.5-4B as clean in that tested build/scenario (16-token miss), so #23589 is not direct negative evidence against Qwen3.5-4B.
corrections.required_test: Still measure repeated and mutated multi-turn VoiceSessionCapsule TTFT, cached/prefill token counts and prompt re-evaluation on the exact pinned Qwen3.5-4B artifact and exact llama.cpp build because absence in one upstream scenario is not a universal guarantee.

corrections.previous_scope_problem: The prior text generalized a Qwen3.5-35B-A3B hybrid-model report to Qwen3.5-4B.
corrections.corrected_observation: Issue #20003 is specifically a Qwen3.5-35B-A3B prompt re-processing report. It motivates a family-level recurrent/cache falsifier but is not model-specific evidence for the 4B baseline.
corrections.required_test: Keep long-context tool-schema/history mutation cases in the 4B benchmark, but do not pre-label 4B as affected.

corrections.previous_scope_problem: The prior wording used a qwen3_5-derived 9B conversion/load failure as if it established a 4B conversion defect.
corrections.corrected_observation: Issue #26916 concerns ShaoShuai0605/Harness-R1 9B with qwen3_5 architecture. It establishes that successful conversion plus quantization does not guarantee loadability for every qwen3_5-derived artifact, but it is not direct evidence that official Qwen3.5-4B fails to load.
corrections.required_test: For the official 4B chain, require exact converter/build pinning, post-conversion load test, post-quantization load test, GGUF metadata receipt and only then benchmark credit.

corrections.observed_scope: Direct Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B GGUF conversion/load report. The issue is open and labeled bug-unconfirmed; the report was updated through 2026-08-06 with an additional user reporting the same symptom.
corrections.observation: The reporter states that Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B has 32 source transformer layers while a converted/quantized artifact was rejected because the loader expected blk.32.attn_norm.weight, i.e. a 33rd block. The report says conversion completed before load failure.
corrections.required_test: Before committing to self-conversion as the production baseline path, pin the exact current llama.cpp build, convert the exact official revision, require a high-precision GGUF load test, then quantize and require a second load test. If either fails with an extra-block/missing-tensor signature, preserve the negative receipt and switch the baseline runtime path rather than patching evidence post hoc.

benchmark_policy.baseline_chain: official pinned safetensors -> exact pinned converter/build -> self-derived GGUF -> load test -> self-quantized Q4_K_M -> load test -> German VoiceSessionCapsule benchmark
benchmark_policy.abliterated_gate: Do not benchmark/promote an abliterated derivative before the official baseline behavior and runtime are measured on the same hardware/build/settings.
benchmark_policy.cache_policy: Treat cache/recurrent behavior as an empirical benchmark dimension, not a presumed Qwen3.5-4B defect.
benchmark_policy.conversion_policy: Treat Qwen3.5-4B GGUF conversion/loadability as an explicit falsifiable gate because direct upstream bug-unconfirmed evidence exists; successful conversion or quantization alone grants zero load/runtime credit.
benchmark_policy.fallback_if_self_conversion_fails: Keep the official safetensors revision as provenance truth and evaluate an official-format local runtime or a separately pinned community GGUF only as a distinct runtime path with converter/uploader provenance recorded. Do not collapse those paths into one baseline identity.
